announced on Tuesday a long-term agreement with Seagate Space to use its Gateway offshore launch platform.
The first mission planned for 2027, with additional launches expected in subsequent years.
The platform is designed to support government and commercial launches, testing, and recovery missions, offering an alternative to traditional land-based launch sites.
The company initially plans to use the platform for defense-related launches and target missions.
Seagate Space has signed its first Gateway platform construction contract and begun advancing the project toward operational readiness.
Kratos President and CEO Eric DeMarco said the partnership will give defense customers more flexibility and additional options for critical launch and testing missions.

title: Kratos partners with Seagate Space for offshore defense launches
